notes: Read all 144 source lines first. Header doc (L4-21: lazy-load rationale, safe-by-default sanitization, new-tab links, CodeBlock delegation) is reproduced and addressed in the native file's header comment.

L1 imports (lazy/Suspense/ReactNode) + L23-27 lazy import of react-markdown/remark-gfm: react-markdown/remark-gfm are DOM renderers and absent from apps/native deps (importing forbidden). Replaced with a dependency-free native markdown renderer (parseBlocks + renderInline) over RN primitives; the React.lazy/Suspense bundle-split is browser-only (Metro bundles statically) so it collapses to a synchronous render — documented in header + here.

L41-60 `code` renderer: fenced code (className `language-xxx` -> match) maps to the inlined native CodeBlockView; inline code (no match, L45-53 styled <code>) maps to the inline `code` mark rendered with styles.inlineCode (bg surface-raised, monospace, ~0.85em).
L61-67 `pre` -> fragment: native fenced code is a single CodeBlockView (no extra wrapper), matching the web collapse of <pre>.
L68-80 `a`: link mark opens via Linking.openURL (native analogue of target=_blank rel=noopener noreferrer); purple-300/underline -> colors.violet + textDecorationLine underline.
L81-86 `ul`/`ol`: ListBlock with ordered flag; bullet (\u2022) or `n.` marker, pl-5/my-1/space-y-0.5 -> styles.list/listItem/listMarker.
L87-95 `h1`/`h2`/`h3`: HeadingBlock levels 1-3 (#{4,6} clamped to 3) -> styles.heading1/2/3 with text-base/text-sm sizes + mt/mb margins, font-semibold via AppText weight.
L96-114 `table`/`th`/`td`: GFM pipe-table parser -> horizontally scrollable TableView with bordered header (surface-2 bg, semibold) and body cells matching border-collapse/px-2/py-1.
L124-127 MarkdownRendererProps `{ children: string }`: preserved verbatim as the exported interface and prop name.

L129-144 MarkdownRenderer + Suspense fallback `

` inside `prose-chat space-y-1`: exported with same name/displayName; root uses gap (space-y-1); the raw-text fallback intent is preserved for the empty/unparseable case (RN keeps explicit newlines).
Sanitization parity is inherent: no DOM and no rehype-raw means raw HTML in the source renders as escaped <Text>, matching the web safe-by-default guarantee (no script execution).

Native-unavailable items documented: clipboard (no @react-native-clipboard/clipboard dep) — the inlined CodeBlockView copy button is gated behind registerChatMarkdownClipboardWriter and renders disabled until a host registers a writer, never claiming success without a real write; underscore-flanked emphasis is intentionally omitted from the inline parser to avoid falsely emphasising snake_case identifiers (** / * / ~~ emphasis, inline code, and links are supported).
Gates: `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint -- --quiet`, and `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles` run green from apps/native after the conversion.
